rateLimits.note: videos.insert has its own default allocation, the Video Uploads bucket: 100 calls a day per Google Cloud project, 1 each (determine_quota_cost and videos/insert, read 2026-11-10). publish() makes one videos.insert (the resumable upload's opening call; the bytes' PUT goes to the URL it answers). Quota resets at midnight Pacific time.

10,000 units a day per project for every method but search.list and videos.insert (determine_quota_cost, read 2026-11-10: videos.list, channels.list and playlistItems.list 1 unit each, videos.delete, videos.update and thumbnails.set 50). An operation costs the units of the methods it makes: account 1 (channels.list), feed 3 (channels.list, playlistItems.list, videos.list; 2 for an empty page), status 1 (videos.list), delete 50 (videos.delete), publish 0 (videos.insert only, the limit above).

provenance.notes: Developer policies (read 2026-11-10): statistics retrieved as Non-Authorized Data stored 30 days at most, other Authorized Data 30 calendar days then deleted or refreshed (III.E.4); tokens kept as long as necessary; a revoked token revoked programmatically and its Authorized Data deleted within 7 days (30 after a revocation on Google's security page); a user's deletion request honoured within 7 days. Every feature showing YouTube content makes YouTube clear as its source with YouTube's brand features, on every device, never obscuring YouTube's attribution (III.F.2; logos per YouTube's branding guidelines). The application links to YouTube's Terms of Service and its users agree to them; its privacy policy, accepted before use, links to Google's and says how to revoke access (III.A). Selling, redistributing or sublicensing the API services is not allowed; ads not sold on a page whose only content is API data (III.G.1); selling an API client is (III.G.2). API credentials never embedded in open-source projects (III.D.1.d). More quota through an API Compliance Audit (III.D.3); YouTube may audit any client (III.H). videos/insert now says videos uploaded from unverified API projects are not restricted to private viewing mode. No idempotency key exists for videos.insert: a resumable upload's session can be resumed, which this provider does not do (an upload that failed is not sent again).
